text_block_list.text:
Despite her deep frustration at missing 
1st place, King Halo heads to the Winning 
Live stage together with Seiun Sky.

If the Arima Kinen is the final race of 
the year, then it's also her last chance 
of the year to express her gratitude to 
her fans.

Their Winning Live turned out to be the 
most electrifying spectacle of the entire 
year.
